release_rule: No entry below 'reviewed' may be shown to a participant. Fill 'missing' with a first-language reviewer, then raise each status.
warning: Every consent-specific term is still missing. Nothing here may be shown to a participant until a first-language reviewer has filled the gaps and raised each status to 'reviewed'.
notes: Clicks: the source types them as ASCII / // ! and = or a double-dagger. Every target here is converted to Unicode U+01C0 (|), U+01C1 (||), U+01C2 (=/), U+01C3 (!). 'source_spelling' keeps the book's own typing so an entry can be checked against the page.

The source is a Peace Corps learner manual, not a dictionary and not a legal text. It can supply greetings, question words, health words and numbers. It cannot supply consent, risk, confidentiality, ethics or signature wording, and those ids are deliberately left in 'missing'.
Khoekhoegowab marks gender and number on nouns with the suffixes -b (masc. sg), -s (fem. sg), -n / -gu / -di (plural). A term glossed here in one form may need another in a sentence.
Tone is not written in the source. Several of these words are tone-distinguished; a reviewer who speaks the language must read them aloud.

t.yes.note: Also written 'ii'. The greeting chapter uses it as the plain yes.

t.do_you_understand.note: Literally 'do you hear/understand'. The manual gives the yes answer as 'î. //nâu!a ta ra'.

t.dont_know.note: The manual glosses this as 'I don't understand'. For 'I don't know' a reviewer must confirm a separate form.

t.thank_you.note: 'Kai gangans' = thank you very much; 'Kai Aios' = great thanks.

t.name_question.note: 'Ti /ons ge a Tim' = my name is Tim.

t.age.note: 'Matiko kurixa du a?' = how old are you; 'Tita ge 24 kurixa' = I am 24 years old. Age is expressed with kurixa, not a noun.

t.listen.note: Verb 'to listen'. 'Ta !ga si' = don't listen. '//nâu' = to hear.

t.read_aloud.note: The manual has 'xoa' = to write but does not give 'to read'. 'khomai' is the standard word; confirm.

t.payment.note: From 'matare' = to pay (verb list). The noun form needs confirming.

t.not_paid.note: Built from 'matare'. Not a sourced sentence.

t.person.note: 'Khoeb' = man, 'Khoes' = woman in the family chapter; the generic is khoe-. Confirm the plural.

t.child.note: Not in the manual. 'skol-/gôan' = learners contains the root. Confirm with a reviewer before use in the assent screens.

t.parent_guardian.note: Not sourced. 'Mamas' = mother, 'Dadab' = father are in the manual. The guardian concept needs a reviewer.

t.language.note: Contained in the language name Khoekhoe-gowab.

t.question.note: From 'tî' = to ask in the verb list. Noun form needs confirming.

t.where_hurt.note: Built from 'mapa' (where) and the health chapter; confirm.
